plugins.name: Lab
plugins.author: MonoOne
plugins.summary: Try agents on a set of cases and compare how each version does.
plugins.description:
Keep sets of real cases in your project, run every version of an agent on them, and compare the results side by side before you trust a version with real work.

Lab ships installed. Removing it hides its screen and keeps its sets on disk.

screenshots.alt: Lab comparing two versions of an agent

plugins.name: Discord
plugins.author: MonoOne
plugins.summary: Start a workflow when someone mentions your bot in a Discord channel.
plugins.description:
Mention your bot in a Discord channel and RigOne starts the workflow you chose, with the message as the task. Agents in that run can reply in Discord through the mcp-discord tool server.

You need a Discord bot with View Channel and Read Message History in that channel, and its token in the DISCORD_TOKEN environment variable.
